prior_summary: Contact-belief adaptive diffusion: a causal two-frame GRU infers an eight-mode soft contact belief and a continuous relative-position latent. One learned epsilon diffusion decoder is conditioned on that belief and predicted contact changes. A learned temporal residual blends current and forecast contact embeddings with entropy/event-dependent retention. Future co-motion supplies weak training labels, and an action-conditioned learned motion predictor couples an auxiliary loss to denoised actions. The fixed interface does not permit changing the executed prefix; adaptive commitment is implemented inside the denoiser, not as an adaptive execution scheduler.
applicable_conditions: Reliable world-frame TCP, red and blue poses, Panda qpos/qvel, finger positions, drawer displacement/velocity and goal coordinates, with up to two causal observations at 20 Hz. Covers the complete expanded insert_blue slice: incoming held-red descent and release, empty travel, blue approach/closure/lift, drawer transport/lowering, optional release and retreat. Switching can occur during finger motion or object lift; contact is inferred rather than certified. Training support assumes a still-open drawer and successful demonstrated contact mechanics.
termination_guidance: Use the supplied simultaneous measured drawer-open, red-on-pad and blue-contained contract. Completion can occur with blue still held near z=0.067 m; release, clearance, speed and sustained holding are not required. Continue this policy for learned release/retreat if desired, using actual fingers opening and TCP-blue separation as continuation cues. A useful optional exit has blue resting near z=0.063 m, each finger near 0.04 m and TCP near z=0.323 m. Contact logits are not a success monitor.
limitations: Only two observation frames and no previous command channel or persistent hidden state are available. Contact targets are weak geometric/co-motion labels without force sensing. The learned motion predictor is neither IK nor a verified simulator. Actions remain shared-normalized absolute joint/gripper targets and are not equivariant or constraint-projected. Execution remains eight steps per invocation under the fixed framework; variable executed prefixes and a 20 Hz persistent belief update are not implemented. Successful-only data do not establish recovery, collision avoidance, uncertainty calibration or better closed-loop performance.

config.architecture: Two-frame GRU contact filter, standard conditional U-Net, event-conditioned temporal epsilon residual, auxiliary recurrent motion model
config.adaptive_implementation: Learned hazard and entropy attenuate persistence of current-contact conditioning across action slots; external execution length remains fixed.
config.normalization: Unmodified shared normalizer from all complete original demonstrations; derived translations use the axiswise maximum of the shared TCP/red/blue position half-ranges.
config.segmentation: All assigned expanded slices, unchanged; no phase cropping or terminal truncation.
config.selection: Last EMA at the fixed predeclared 20000-update budget, seed 0.
